# ДАДоО vs «Зведений каталог метричних книг», т. 4 (2012), с. 9–207 — anomaly report

**Status: A, D, C, B applied to prod on 2026-08-21** via `migration.sql` (generated by `generate.py` from `analysis/catalog-parsed.json` + the DB snapshot in `analysis/db-*.tsv`; row-level inputs in `01-glued.csv`, `02-missing-files.csv`, `03-fonds.csv`, `04-bare-files.csv`). Result: inventories 307→293, files 4210→4185, fonds without title 95→11 (non-church Р-fonds), fonds with year ranges 2→268, files without title 155→75, without years 73→37, tagged «метрична книга» 4052→4095, online copies unchanged (3409), `file_authors` 5921→5884 (exact duplicate links only). **E applied 2026-08-21** via `migration-e.sql` (`generate_e.py`, input/audit `05-years.csv`): 208 files re-dated to the catalog ranges; year-ordering inversions in the affected fonds went 44→27. **A2 applied 2026-08-21** via `migration-a2.sql` (`06-glued-3digit.csv`): 11 more duplicates with 3-digit glued codes (`198-1-183`≡`198-1-8`, …) removed — found because their years broke the per-fond ordering after E. Final: 4174 files, 1 orphaned-years class left (see below).

To re-run the pipeline for another archive in this volume (ДАІФО с. 228–310, ДАЛуО с. 312–455, ДАОО с. 457–521, ДАПО с. 522–733): `pdftotext -f <from> -l <to> tom4.pdf`, adapt the archive code/section headings in `analysis/parse_pdf.py`, dump the DB tables with the queries in `analysis/compare.py`'s header, then `generate.py`.

Read-only analysis, 2026-08-21. Source parsed from `tom4.pdf` (pdftotext) and cross-checked with the OCR `mbv4.txt` — the two agree on every fond's book count, every header year range and every справа's years. Parsed: **273 fonds, 273 detail blocks, 4 080 distinct справи** (ф.–оп.–спр.). DB scope: archive `ДАДоО` — 408 fonds, 307 inventories, 4 210 files.

All 273 catalog fonds exist in the DB, and no church fond in the DB is absent from the catalog. No year ranges in the DB are out of bounds (start>end, <1300, >2030). The anomalies fall into the classes below.

## B. Catalog справи present in the DB but bare — 78 rows
- no title: 77; no `метрична книга` tag: 78; no years: 35. Concentrated in Ф. 356 (34 of 35 files), Ф. 201 (16 of 17), Ф. 359 (7 of 8); the rest: Ф. 312 (4), Ф. 198 (2), Ф. 226 (1), Ф. 304 (1), Ф. 215 (1), Ф. 324 (1), Ф. 189 (1), Ф. 378 (1), Ф. 451 (1), Ф. 199 (1), Ф. 293 (1), Ф. 219 (1), Ф. 335 (1), Ф. 344 (1), Ф. 54 (1), Ф. 439 (1), Ф. 421 (1).
- Fix from the catalog: title in the sibling files' format (`Метрична книга. <церква>, <місце>`, e.g. Ф. 356 → `Метрична книга. Олександро-Невська церква, с. Олександрівка Ізюмського пов.`), tags from the record kinds listed for that справа (народження / шлюб / смерть; item 9 = шлюбні обшуки or сповідні відомості), years from the catalog.

## C. Fond metadata
- **84 fonds have no title** in the DB (Ф. 404, 405, 406, 407, 408, 409, 410, 411, 412, 413, … mostly Ф. 404–487); the catalog gives the full name → fill.
- **271 of 273 fonds have no chronological range** (`fond_years`); the catalog header gives precise multi-range dates (Ф. 20: 1873–1894, 1897–1926) → fill. Ф. 211 is the only one with years — a single 1866–1922 span where the catalog has five ranges.
- **Ф. 204 has the wrong title**: DB = «Церква Скорботних радощів …, сл. Богородичне» (that is Ф. 205); catalog = «Різдво-Богородицька церква Харківської духовної консисторії, с. Хрестище Ізюмського повіту Харківської губернії» → replace.
- 114 other titles differ only in style (`сл.`/`слобода`, `сел.`/`с-ще`, `Предтечи`/`Предтечі`, extra волость / «(з 1874 р. – Маріупольського)» clauses); the catalog version is the fuller one. Decision: keep DB style or adopt the catalog wholesale.

## E. Years that disagree with the catalog — 208 справи in 75 fonds (decision, not auto-fix)
Catalog years are the union of the birth/marriage/death ranges per справа; DB years came from the archive's описи. Two patterns:
- **Systematic ±1 shift in 9 fonds (68 справи)**: Ф. 190, 192, 197, 204, 212, 215, 221, 245, 433 — DB years of спр. N equal the catalog's years of спр. N±1 for nearly every file (Ф. 212: DB 1-8 = 1890–1891, catalog 1-8 = 1889 and 1-9 = 1890–1891 …). One side's numbering is off by one for the whole run; check 1–2 files against FamilySearch images (Ф. 212/215 have copies) before moving anything.
- **Isolated differences (140)**: e.g. `198-1-1` DB 1917–1918 vs catalog 1853–1864; `102-1-21…32` DB ranges belong to other справи; `202-1-4/5`, `203-1-9…11`, `205-1-1`. Several look like a DB row carrying a neighbour's years. Full list: `analysis/report-raw.md` §6.
- Catalog typos to ignore: `226-1-1` «1772–1872» (=1871–1872); refs to «ф. 1» (=312) and «ф. 74» (=274).

## F2. Post-catalog additions — keep
36 files above the catalog's last справа with years 1917–1924 and FamilySearch copies (e.g. `208-1-17..19`, `223-1-13..15`, `226-1-34..36`, `324-1-35/36`, `459-1-2/5`) are books accessioned after 2012; most lack a title/tags — not fixable from this source. `260-1-48` is genuine (Ф. 260 keeps births in odd and deaths in even справи).

## F. Letter-suffixed files not in the catalog — keep
`193-1-28А`, `193-1-31А`, `198-1-9А`, `202-1-6А`, `203-1-8А`, `204-1-7А`, `205-1-7А`, `205-1-8А`, `212-1-7А`, `365-1-1А`: absent from the 2012 catalog, but 7 of 10 have FamilySearch copies, so they are real later additions. `198-1-9А`, `205-1-7А`, `205-1-8А` have no years/title — not fixable from this source.

## G. Counts
64 fonds disagree between «справ метричних книг» in the catalog and files tagged `метрична книга` in the DB; A and B explain nearly all of it — recompute after those fixes. Residual special cases: Ф. 121 (no inventory), Ф. 155/244/245/273 (catalog summary has no count line).

## H. Not fixable from this catalog
301 of 307 ДАДоО inventories have no title and none have years (the catalog has nothing at опис level); 155 files in the archive have no title, of which only the B set is covered here.


## Proposed fix order (read-write phase)
1. A — move copy `226-14-8`→`226-1-8`; merge `451-1-2149`→`451-1-2` and `260-156-48`→`260-1-48`; 3 renames; delete 29 duplicate files and 15 empty inventories.
2. D — create inventory `121-1` and 7 files.
3. C — fill 84 fond titles and 269 fond year sets; fix the Ф. 204 title.
4. B — fill title/tags/years for the bare files.
5. E — decide per fond after spot-checks; separate migration.
Everything as SQL + CSV under `migration/2026-08-21-dadoo-mbv4/` per repo convention.
